regions.full_page: This is how far I got this Morning when you called. As I told you, "just started." Now, at all events: "God bless you" Miss Grace L. Panyard, I feel will be in place and will be ap- preciated. Thanks be to God; I was surely pleased at the tone of your call over that of your letter received a day or two before yes- terday. Let us pray and trust that, God willing, things continue to brighten. Nevertheless, it is always good to keep the short- ness of time in mind as compared - better contrasted - with eter- nity. Good too that we remember again and again, whether we succeed or fail in our plans and efforts - good to remember the reminder of the Psalmist: "Unless the Lord build the house, they labor in vain who build it. "Unless the Lord keep the City, they watch in vain who keep it." . . . Well God bless you again Miss Grace L. and all your efforts and all with whome you have associa- tion. I'm trying to catch the daily mail Collector and he is lia- ble to toot any minute.
